sealed_record.thesis: The market still prices ETH mostly as a lagging high-beta crypto asset, but the more important setup is structural tokenization demand. zeroxkyle argues the first wave is US stablecoin-led and the second wave arrives when Europe and other sovereigns respond with CBDCs; Norgesbank is already building one. Separately, early analysis showing roughly 65% APR on RWAs via Turbo Desk suggests real demand for on-chain yield and treasury products now. If tokenization broadens from a US phenomenon to a sovereign-led one, ETH remains the most established public settlement layer to absorb that activity.

outcome.thesis_note: DITUTUP -25.2%. Ditutup dalam unwind seluruh buku call. Long kripto ikut turun bersama pasar (BTC ~$64,8 ribu).
